visualCharacteristics: New: full cell grid (outer box plus vertical and horizontal 1px rules) with a bold first (header) row.

usage.description: Data table with a full cell grid and a bold header row; scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.

reuseGuidance: Use for tabular data where every cell boundary should be visible (directories, calendars). Use table-row-lines for lighter lists with horizontal rules only.
tableStructure: First row: header cells (bold). Following rows: one data row each, one cell per column; empty cells are allowed
